summary: Frontend-only verification of home banner edge-to-edge fix. VERIFIED: banner wrap and image both render at x=0 with width=390 (full viewport). Computed styles: marginLeft=0px, marginRight=0px, borderRadius=0px, aspectRatio=1.77778/1 (16:9). Banner remains tappable and correctly navigates to /products on tap. Regression checks pass: header search button retained at x=334 (right padding intact), announcement pill at x=16 w=358 (16pt side margins intact), stats and featured products render below and remain padded. No red screen, no navigation breakage. Minor: one deprecation console warning about `style.resizeMode` (React Native Web recommends props.resizeMode) — cosmetic only, image renders correctly because source aspect matches 16:9 container.

react_native_issues.issue: `resizeMode: 'cover'` is set inside StyleSheet — React Native Web logs deprecation: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Move to `<Image resizeMode="cover" ... />` prop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:186 (style) and :101 (Image element).

action_items: Optional cleanup: move `resizeMode: 'cover'` from styles.bannerImage (line 186) to a prop on the <Image> component (line 101) to silence React Native Web deprecation warning. Not blocking — image renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Banner CSS-style fix implemented correctly: styles.bannerWrap.marginHorizontal=0 and borderRadius=0. aspectRatio 16/9 preserved. testID 'home-banner' and 'home-banner-image' both present. TouchableOpacity onPress -> /(tabs)/products working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home banner is now edge-to-edge (x=0, w=viewport). All regression checks pass. Only cosmetic deprecation warning for style.resizeMode remains.
rca_of_issue: N/A — bug already fixed and verified. Root cause was marginHorizontal: spacing.lg (16pt) + borderRadius: radius.lg (20pt) creating side gutters. Both set to 0 in styles.bannerWrap, resulting in true edge-to-edge banner while other blocks retain their padding.
